newsitem.title: USA: National Service Indus unit to be bought.
newsitem.headline: National Service Indus unit to be bought.

text.p: Performance Contracting Group Inc said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to buy North Bros. Inc, a subsidiary of National Services Industries Inc of Atlanta.
Terms were not disclosed, but the company said the price is slightly above book value of the net assets.

Performance Contracting is the parent of Performance Contracting Inc, an international contractor that provides specialty contracting services to the mechanical, power, process, cleanroom, cold storage and marine construction industries.
North Bros. is engaged in insulation contracting, industrial cleaning and materials sales and distribution in the southeastern United States.
